vanilla_changes.change: Naming no longer needs an anvil or XP; shears remove names and return the tag; old tags are returned on rename; named mobs may drop their tag on death.

mechanics.title: Instant editing
mechanics.description: Use a name tag to open an edit screen and set its name; no anvil or XP needed. Formatting codes allow colors, bold, italics, etc.

mechanics.title: No wasted tags
mechanics.description: Applying a tag with the same name as the mob's current name does not consume it.

mechanics.title: Removing names
mechanics.description: Using shears on a named mob removes its custom name and gives back the matching name tag.

mechanics.title: Death drops
mechanics.description: Named mobs can drop their name tag when they die.

mechanics.title: Renaming
mechanics.description: Renaming an already named mob returns the previous name tag instead of discarding it.

mechanics.title: Feedback
mechanics.description: Applying a name tag plays a sound.

qol: Rename name tags on the go
Recover name tags from named mobs with shears
getting_started: Use (right-click) a name tag in your hand to open the naming screen, then right-click a mob with the named tag.
editor_notes: Exact conditions for the death drop (chance/config) are not documented in the page; config is in config/nametagupgrade-*.toml. Needed on both client and server.
name: Name Tag Upgrade
summary: Name tags can be renamed on the spot by using them, with no anvil or experience cost, and formatting codes are supported. Name tags are also no longer wasted when renaming or removing names.
